gate_results.evidence: Three distinct held cards are visible together: selected ECHO STEP in the nearer hand and STONE/SPARK in the opposite hand. Their hands belong to the same explorer.

A continuous cyan curve visibly reaches from the selected card toward luminous footprints in the left floor/tunnel. The bronze sentinel and open bright right-side passage are visible. Its trumpet mouth points up/right rather than unambiguously at those left-floor marks; current guard-to-same-footprints orientation is therefore unproven. The forward leg exits the lower frame, hiding its boot and its threshold contact, so the selected-card/marks/guard/vacated-route/crossing chain is incomplete.

The selected card clearly reads ECHO STEP. The nearby explorer-associated panel repeats ECHO STEP and visibly reads MP 0/2. This proves displayed bounded-resource information, not a real decrement or algorithmic rule.

Direct comparison with the observed guide supports a straight dark bob, separated fringe, large dark eyes, softly rounded facial appearance and softly full lips. No identity, actual age, motive or consent is inferred.

Salt-like crystalline walls, mining lanterns, a deep left tunnel and a bright right-side doorway establish an underground mine-like environment with distinguishable openings. One rear boot is planted. The forward boot is cropped by the lower edge, so both-boot support and the required exit-crossing transition cannot be observed together.
